description: This file defines classes and functions related to theming in the Wesnoth game, including theme object positioning, labels, status items, panels, menus, and resolution handling. It also includes functions for resolving configuration references and partial resolutions.

classes.name: theme::object
classes.description: Represents a theming object with position and anchoring properties.

classes.name: theme::label
classes.description: Represents a text or icon label within a theme.

classes.name: theme::status_item
classes.description: Represents a status display item with optional label.

classes.name: theme::panel
classes.description: Represents a panel element with an image.

classes.name: theme::menu
classes.description: Represents a menu, including context menus and items.

classes.name: theme::theme
classes.description: Main theme class managing resolution, panels, labels, menus, and theme configurations.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Calculates and returns the position of a theme object relative to a given screen rectangle.

methods.name: read_anchor
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the anchoring type for positioning.

methods.name: set_resolution
methods.description: Sets the theme resolution based on the provided screen size, selecting the best matching resolution configuration.

methods.name: get_status_item
methods.description: Retrieves a status item by key.

methods.name: main_map_location
methods.description: Returns the location rectangle for the main map element.

methods.name: mini_map_location
methods.description: Returns the location rectangle for the mini map element.

methods.name: set_known_themes
methods.description: Loads known themes from a configuration.

methods.name: get_known_themes
methods.description: Returns a list of known theme names.
